title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Stand guard? How annoying... Fine.

title: Talk 1
original: That Amiya girl is one of this place's leaders? What a black-hearted company Rhodes Island is.

title: Talk 2
original: I'm not about to freeload here. Just let me know if you need some elbow grease.

title: Talk 3
original: I have nothing against taking orders, but I don't like fighting without knowing why I'm doing it.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: My hobbies? Why should I tell you? Ugh... Alright, alright, I'll tell you. Just stop making that face... I like tinkering.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Without Chiave and Aosta, I'd be a corpse in an alley. I owe them my life. So no matter what they want, I'll help them without a second thought.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I don't hate you, but... I find it difficult to fully trust you.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Do what you're told, keep the wolf from the door, live life. They all seemed like simple ideas once to me... But Aosta was right. In a country like Siracusa, things like those aren't ideas, they're dreams.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: I gotta say, your leadership skills are decent... But Aosta once said that an organization turns rotten when people let their guard down. So, I'll be keeping a close eye on you.

title: Idle
original: Asleep? What a carefree Doctor... Gah, where'd the blanket go…?

title: Onboard
original: Since Chiave decided I'm joining you, I don't have much else to say. You can call me Broca. I'll follow your orders, but don't count on me doing anything extra. I have no love for big organizations like yours.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Thanks.

title: Promotion 1
original: A raise...? Don't particularly need one.

title: Promotion 2
original: Maybe Aosta was right, maybe Rhodes Island is actually trustworthy. And if so…

title: Added to Squad
original: Alright.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: ...I'm not good at leading.

title: Depart
original: Let's go.

title: Begin Operation
original: Time to fight.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Don't try to micromanage me.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Tch... Got it.

title: Deployment 1
original: Are those the enemies?

title: Deployment 2
original: I can handle it.

title: In Battle 1
original: This won't hurt for long.

title: In Battle 2
original: Let's get this over with.

title: In Battle 3
original: Die, you moron!

title: In Battle 4
original: Shaddap you face.

title: 4-star Result
original: Alright… You've got a few tricks.

title: 3-star Result
original: They've all been taken care of.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Need me to go after them?

title: Operation Failure
original: Relax. You did what you could. Even Aosta makes mistakes.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: I'll take a look around.

title: Tap
original: Hey…!

title: Trust Tap
original: You're pretty annoying, Doctor.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year, Doctor... What? I have to pay for my freeloading. Besides, occasions like these are incredible to me. Comparing to my time in Siracusa, Rhodes Island is decent.

title: Greeting
original: Morning.

title: Birthday
original: I've never given anyone a present before, so I'm not too good at picking. Aosta said I should make one myself. Here, it's a block of carving wood, anti-mold treated by me. Tung oil, stops it rotting. When I'm not around, you can move it in front of your desk, and treat it like I'm supervising you.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I didn't think I'd run into you here. I just finished cleaning up my workbench— there's been a lot of orders in for weapons lately. Why haven't I been supervising you lately? Because you don't seem like you're about to turn rotten these days. And I approve of your goals. Let's work hard together, Doctor.
